scope: Synthetic scanner implementation review, not findings of real source secrets

rounds.before: semantic predicate accepted synthetic unsafe construct
rounds.after: each candidate must belong to its own complete reviewed expression

rounds.issue: Header/cookie interpolation suffix and literal concatenation could be classified as runtime-only
rounds.before: synthetic predicates accepted appended literal values
rounds.after: whole literal and whole runtime value expression enforced

rounds.issue: Arbitrary credential call/default argument and identity generator suffix could be classified as runtime-only
rounds.after: narrow full expression grammar; no arbitrary call or default value

rounds.issue: Safe detector suffix did not validate the literal prefix
rounds.before: fresh metadata plus altered synthetic detector produced scanner PASS
rounds.after: whole reviewed detector expression fingerprint enforced

rounds.issue: Evidence path and binary text integration caused source-file and compressed-PNG false positives
rounds.before: source filename containing evidence rejected and PNG compressed bytes produced soft email findings
rounds.after: evidence directories distinguished; only validated PNG excludes soft text parsing; HARD and metadata checks preserved

rounds.issue: Invalid UTF-8 byte could suppress soft scanning for non-image evidence
rounds.before: synthetic invalid-byte text evidence produced scanner PASS
rounds.after: non-image undecodable evidence fails and remains soft-scanned; fake PNG also fails

rounds.issue: Narrow SQL singleton approval needed soft scanning of adjacent literals
rounds.before: Static coverage gap identified during review; not an observed production secret
rounds.after: SQL included in unchanged SITES rule scanning; fresh DDL metadata cannot suppress adjacent credential/email/cookie findings
